title: swerepo-ci.yml tests exactly the Python versions each project declares
assertion: In the `.github/workflows/swerepo-ci.yml` that `swerepo init` writes, the `test` job's matrix is exactly the Python versions the root project's `requires-python` allows (3.11 to 3.14 when it declares none), each listed project's `test-<name>` job uses its own project's versions, and `test-macos` runs on the newest declared version. Tried with `>=3.12`, `>=3.11,<3.14`, no declaration, and a listed project declaring `>=3.13`.

origin.text: ADR-20261122-4a06 point 7 and SWEREPO-SPEC §6.2: CI tests every Python version the project supports, from requires-python, and never changes the declared range. Split from inv_09cc1c20 after SeamSpec's reviewer asked for each test job and more than one range to be checked.
